Sara Chen: Short follow-up from the postmortem: we need final statuspage copy, decide RCA sharing for affected customers, and assign owners for outreach and remediation. Can we agree actions now?

Matt Dobson: Draft statuspage: "We experienced elevated latency in the Embeddings pipeline due to tokenization worker exhaustion. Mitigations applied; normal service resumed. Full RCA due within 72 hours." Add contact line? :memo:

Yun Park: Add a single contact for customer-specific impact summaries (support@redwood.ai) and call out the 72h ETA. I'll pull the affected-customer hits and share a CSV.

Kevin O'Neill: For customers with PII or contractual restrictions offer a redacted RCA + optional private walk-through. I can draft the invite + two proposed time slots. Need legal on redaction.

Emily Garza: Legal OK with redacted RCAs and walk-throughs provided we follow a redaction checklist and don't disclose internal-only metrics. I'll prepare the checklist and flag customers who need explicit consent.

Sara Chen: Actions: Emily - legal redaction checklist and support guidance (48h). Matt - post statuspage with 72h RCA ETA and contact line (2h). Yun - affected-customer CSV + handoff to Support (18h). Kevin - walk-through invite template + windows (72h). Sara - raise reliability epic for tokenization pattern (1 week).

Matt Dobson: I'll post the statuspage now with the 72h note and contact instructions.

Yun Park: Query running, will share the CSV and include request-level counts for prioritization.

Emily Garza: I'll email Legal flags and then hand the list to Yun for classification, plus write support guidance.

IncidentBot: Postmortem doc updated in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/pm/tokenization-outage — add action updates there.

Sara Chen: Noted this is the third tokenization latency incident in 6 months; let's make the epic recurring to avoid repeats. I'll open the epic proposal. Confirm owners?

Matt Dobson: Confirmed.

Yun Park: Confirmed.

Kevin O'Neill: Confirmed.

Emily Garza: Confirmed.

Sara Chen: I'll check back in 48h with status. Ping me for blockers. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
